changeHypothesis.summary: Russia/Belarus supply disruption made the global potash shortage more acute. 藏格 had low-cost potash and lithium economics with strong 2021 earnings, but the Mar13 forecast already embedded the sanctions/high-price regime and projected only modest growth after the 2022 step-up. The stock also entered a late-reversal price state.
changeHypothesis.persistenceReason: Supply disruption can last multiple quarters, but demand destruction/new supply and already-high prices limit duration certainty.
disconfirmingEvidence: The Mar13 forecast already cited Belarus/Russia supply risk and high potash/lithium prices.
2022-24 profit path was RMB4.775/5.080/5.160bn, meaning most step-up was already in 2022.
The stock was late_reversal: 20d underperformed while 60d still outperformed.
